title: Add auth access control MVP

context.summary: Implement MVP bearer-token verification and project-scoped route authorization for the API runtime.
context.background: The MVP PRD requires access tokens with multi-project scopes and project-level authorization. TASK-15 wired repositories but left auth as a placeholder; TASK-17 activates auth for the server runtime while keeping bare app factory placeholders for scaffold tests.

in: Implement shared auth types, token hashing and permission helpers in @mindory/auth.
Add a Drizzle-backed access token repository using access_tokens and access_token_project_scopes.
Wire the API server runtime to verify bearer tokens through the database repository.
Enforce project-scoped permissions in project, peer, session, message, document, memory and context routes.
Return structured 401/403 API errors for missing, invalid or insufficient bearer tokens.
Keep health/readiness public and keep placeholder auth for bare buildApiApp dependency-injection scenarios.
Update docs and validation scripts for active auth runtime behavior.
out: Add token creation, revocation or listing HTTP endpoints.
Add document-level ACLs, memory-level ACLs, group roles or policy engine behavior.
Implement jobs API, worker processing or vector search.
Add live database seed tooling for access tokens.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/auth exports the MVP permission list, AuthorizationContext, token hashing, verification and project permission helpers.
@mindory/db exports DbAccessTokenRepository and uses token_hash plus scope rows for verification.
API runtime dependencies include access token verification when the server is built from config.
Protected API routes check the correct project permission before repository operations.
Missing or invalid bearer tokens return 401 and insufficient project scopes return 403.
Bare buildApiApp calls without auth dependencies still use placeholder auth and do not grant project permissions.
Docs and validation scripts describe active auth runtime behavior.

manual_checks: Confirm raw bearer tokens are not logged or stored.
Confirm health and readiness routes remain public.
Confirm token create/revoke/list endpoints remain out of scope.

risks: No token creation API exists yet, so runtime tokens must be seeded or inserted until a later task adds token management.
Project listing filters in memory after repository listing for the MVP and should be tightened when broader project counts matter.
The auth runtime compiles and is structurally validated but is not exercised against a live PostgreSQL database in this task.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
